I’m Rohan Shah, the proud owner of Travelpedia, and it’s my absolute pleasure to share this testimonial for Mr. Lakshmikant Sharma.

After a gap of nearly 20 years since I last played the drums, I felt the urge to reconnect with music—this time through strings. When I met Mr. Lakshmikant with the intention of learning guitar, he suggested I try the mandolin instead. His conviction and expertise instantly won me over, and I began my mandolin journey under his guidance.

Mr. Lakshmikant is not only a professional mandolin artist but also a master of all string instruments. What truly sets him apart is his humility, depth of knowledge, and a unique teaching style that makes learning both enjoyable and effective.

In just two months, I’ve seen a remarkable improvement in my skills. His attention to detail, focus on fundamentals, and personal attention have made all the difference. He teaches students ranging from 12 to 90 years old with the same enthusiasm and dedication, which speaks volumes about his patience and passion for teaching.

I wholeheartedly recommend Mr. Lakshmikant Sharma to anyone looking to learn the mandolin, guitar, or any string instrument. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone rediscovering music like me, you're in the best hands with him.

🎼 Valuable Tips for Music Teachers — Dr. Kim

• Love your students unconditionally
See each child as unique and precious. Create a safe, warm space where they feel valued beyond their performance.

• Earn their trust
Be consistent, patient, and genuine. When students know you are for them, they open up and learn with freedom.

• Encourage always
Celebrate small steps. Speak life-giving words that build confidence and inspire them to keep going.

• Challenge appropriately
Give tasks that stretch them just enough. Age-appropriate challenges help them grow without feeling overwhelmed.

name: Mehli Mehta Music Foundation
description: Established in 1995, the Mehli Mehta Music Foundation (MMMF) is a not-for-profit organization that promotes western classical music through the presentation of high quality concerts and music education for children. The Foundation honours the late Mr. Mehli Mehta ( 1908 – 2002 ) , a conductor and violinist who lived in Bombay until 1954 before he emigrated to the UK and subsequently to the US, where he was conductor of the American Symphony for 33 glorious years. Between 1930 and 1954 he mentored a whole generation of aspiring musicians in Bombay and was the Founder of the Bombay String Quartet and the Bombay Symphony Orchestra.

featured_reviews.name: jalpa rana
featured_reviews.review_text:
An excellent music class with a very strong foundation in both instrumental and vocal training. The instrument classes—keyboard, harmonium, and guitar—are conducted with great clarity and discipline, making learning enjoyable and effective for children.
The vocal music classes are personally taken by the owner, Nanu Gurjar, whose dedication truly shows in the way students are guided. What stands out most is the individual attention given to each child and the immense patience with which they are handled.
It’s reassuring to see a place where learning is not rushed, and children are encouraged, supported, and nurtured at their own pace. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality music education for their kids.
